positive_terms: Disclosure of quantitative and qualitative information regarding progress of actions or action plans disclosed in prior periods
Disclosure of quantitative and qualitative information regarding progress of actions or action plans disclosed in prior periods。先前行动计划进展。按可持续主题、行动对象、期间和范围复用；当前与未来、资本与运营资源分别保存；未采纳行动的分支不能充当行动事实。
